title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Bolton
Salary: Up to £28,000 Basic Salary OTE £36,000 Uncapped
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Looking for a role where your customer service skills are recognised, your earning potential is rewarded, and your work-life balance is respected?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Service Advisor to join a busy and successful dealership environment where customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything they do. With uncapped bonus potential, a supportive team culture, and a reduced Saturday rota following training, this role offers both financial reward and long-term career stability.

Up to £28,000 Basic Salary
Uncapped OTE of £36,000
Monday to Friday Working Hours
1 in 2 Saturday Mornings, Reducing to 1 in 3 Following Training
Full-Time, Permanent Position

Ongoing Training & Development
Career Progression Opportunities
Long-Term Job Stability

As a Service Advisor, you will be the key point of contact between customers and the workshop, ensuring every customer receives a professional and seamless service experience from booking through to vehicle collection.

Key responsibilities include:
Managing service and repair bookings efficiently
Coordinating workshop loading to maximise productivity

Liaising closely with technicians and the workshop team

Delivering exceptional customer service at every stage of the journey

We're keen to hear from candidates who can demonstrate:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within the automotive industry
Strong customer service and communication skills
Proven experience upselling products, services or additional work
Experience using Kerridge, 1 Link, Pinnacle or a similar Dealer Management System (DMS)
The ability to work effectively in a busy, fast-paced environment
Excellent organisational and administrative skills
A positive, professional and customer-focused attitude
Full UK Manual Driving Licence (subject to licence checks)

Alternative job titles may include: Service Advisor, Senior Service Advisor, Aftersales Advisor, Service Receptionist or Automotive Service Advisor.

APPLY TODAY
This is an excellent opportunity to join a successful automotive business that values its employees, rewards performance, and offers genuine opportunities for career development.

Interested in finding out more? Apply today or contact Howard at Auto Skills for a confidential discussion about this Service Advisor opportunity, quoting job reference 54039.

title: Accounts Assistant
company: WHITAKER SMITH RECRUITMENT LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Based: Bolton (BL5)

Salary: circa £32k + benefits including enhanced pension, health shield, 25 days + birthday + bank holidays.

Hours: 8am-4pm or 9am-5pm (30 min lunch). Office based, potentially 1 day WFH after probation

An established and expanding international business is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant to join its finance team. Having seen consistent organic growth over the last few years, the business is continuing to develop their products & services and offers the opportunity to join a successful, forward-thinking organisation with plenty happening behind the scenes! This is a varied, hands-on accounts position, covering all aspects of the day-to-day finance function. We're looking for someone who enjoys getting stuck into the detail, takes ownership of their workload and has the confidence and experience to work independently.

Role:

Working closely with the Finance Manager and Finance Director, you'll take responsibility for a broad range of accounting duties, including:
- Managing purchase ledger activities, including invoice processing, supplier queries and reconciliations.
- Supporting sales ledger processes, ensuring accurate invoicing and allocation of receipts.
- Taking ownership of credit control, proactively managing outstanding balances and resolving queries.
- Completing bank reconciliations, investigating unidentified transactions and tracing payments through to the correct purchases, invoices and accounts.
- Identifying and resolving discrepancies, using your initiative to investigate issues rather than simply processing transactions.
- Supporting the Finance Manager and Finance Director with additional accounting and finance-related activities as required.
- Playing a part in an upcoming ERP system implementation over the next 12 months, with exposure to new processes and systems

Experience:
- At least 5 years experience in a finance role with well-rounded experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and bank reconciliations.
- Excellent attention to detail and a natural ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
- The ability to prioritise your own workload, work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities.
- A proactive, practical approach and the confidence to hit the ground running.
- Good Excel skills and experience working with accounting systems.
- Previous exposure to NetSuite would be advantageous, although not essential

Please send your CV for immediate consideration, interviews are happening in the next couple of weeks!

Production Administrator / Estimating Assistant

Location: Bolton
Salary: £28 K £32 K per annum
Recruitment for: Right Hire Recruitment
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and commercially minded Production Administrator / Estimating Assistant to join our team in Bolton.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, specifications and processes and is interested in developing a career within estimating, costing and production.

You will work closely with our Estimating and Bidding Team, providing essential administrative and technical support throughout the estimating and tender process. The role would suit an experienced administrator with an interest in manufacturing/engineering, or a recent engineering graduate looking to build a career in estimating and commercial costing.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the estimating and bidding team.
- Assist with the preparation and submission of quotations and tenders.
- Review customer enquiries, drawings, specifications and supporting documentation.
- Help gather information and pricing from suppliers and internal departments.
- Assist with material, labour and production cost calculations.
- Maintain accurate costing, quotation and tender records.
- Input and update information on internal systems and spreadsheets.
- Liaise with production, purchasing, engineering and other departments to obtain relevant information.
- Assist with monitoring tender deadlines and ensuring quotations are completed on time.
- Prepare reports, schedules and other documentation as required.
- Help maintain accurate product, material and pricing information.
- Support the team with general administration and coordination of production and estimating activities.

About You

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organised and methodical.

Comfortable working with numbers and detailed information.

Confident using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

A good communicator who can work effectively with different departments.

Able to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.

Naturally curious and keen to understand how products are made and costed.

Commercially aware and interested in developing their estimating skills.

A proactive team player with a willingness to learn.

Engineering Graduates Welcome

We would particularly welcome applications from recent graduates with an engineering degree who are interested in developing a career in estimating, costing, tendering or commercial engineering.

You do not necessarily need previous estimating experience. What matters is a strong numerical and analytical approach, attention to detail and the enthusiasm to learn.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Strong attention to detail.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Good written and verbal communication.
- Competent IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Ability to organise workload and meet deadlines.
- A genuine interest in estimating, costing and production.

Desirable:
- Previous experience in administration, manufacturing, engineering or estimating.
- An engineering or technical qualification.
- Experience working with quotations, purchase orders, bills of materials or costing.
- Knowledge of manufacturing or production processes.

What We Offer
- Salary of £28 K £32 K depending on experience and suitability.
- Full-time, permanent position based in Bolton.
- Opportunity to develop specialist skills in estimating and costing.
- Training and support from an experienced estimating and bidding team.
- Excellent opportunity for an engineering graduate to establish a career within a commercial/technical environment.
- A varied role with exposure to production, engineering, purchasing and commercial activities.

How to Apply

If you are organised, numerate and looking to develop a career within estimating and costing, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV to Right Hire Recruitment for consideration.

title: Customer Account Coordinator

description:
What if you could join a highly successful, market-leading business without losing the friendly, personal feel of a family-owned company? This could be a great opportunity to join a well-established business just outside Leigh town centre, where you can build strong customer relationships, work with a great team and develop a genuine long-term career.

Along with a 27,000 starting salary, rising to 28,000 after 6 months, you'll benefit from 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 25 days plus bank holidays including your birthday, an early finish every other Friday and free parking. You'll also be joining a friendly, supportive team where people know each other, work closely together and are encouraged to develop.

What will you be doing as Customer Account Coordinator?
Working as part of a small and friendly team, you'll be helping customers with their day-to-day requirements while developing strong, long-term relationships. It's a varied, fast-moving role where building genuine customer relationships is just as important as getting the job done.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Speaking with existing and lapsed customers and developing strong relationships
- Handling inbound enquiries and making outbound calls to customers
- Preparing quotes and advising customers on product suitability and availability
- Liaising with suppliers in the UK and overseas to obtain pricing and product information
- Working with customers and internal departments to resolve any issues
- Keeping customer websites updated with the latest product range

What's in it for you?
- A 27,000 starting salary, rising to 28,000 after 6 months
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 25 days plus bank holidays including your birthday
- An early finish every other Friday
- Free parking
- Regular staff rewards, treats and incentives
- Regular social events
- Staff discount
- Staff referral bonus
- Support for employees who want to get involved in charity work
- Excellent career and development opportunities
- A friendly, supportive working environment with a genuine family feel

Why would you join this company?
This is a successful and well-established family-owned business with a multi-million-pound turnover and a strong position within its sector. Despite its size and continued success, it has retained the friendly, personal approach that makes it feel like a place where people genuinely know and support each other.

You'll be joining a business that values its people and invests in their development, with opportunities to learn, take on more responsibility and build a long-term career.

It's also an environment where people work hard but enjoy what they do. There's a real team spirit, regular rewards and social events, and a culture where everyone plays their part in the success of the business.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in a Customer Account Coordinator, Sales Administration, Sales Support, Customer Service, Internal Sales, Account Management or a similar role
- Office-based experience and a confident, friendly telephone manner
- Good working knowledge of Word, Excel and email
- A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership
- The ability to build rapport and develop positive customer relationships

What's important to the company:
We're not looking for someone who simply ticks every box. Your personality and approach are just as important as your experience.

You'll ideally be someone who is upbeat, outgoing and enjoys talking to people. Someone who takes an interest in understanding what customers need, likes getting things done and wants to become someone their customers can rely on.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Sullivan Way Surgery is looking to recruit an experienced, enthusiastic and reliable Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice in Wigan. We are seeking someone with previous GP practice reception experience who understands the demands of primary care and can provide a professional, efficient and compassionate service to our patients. The successful candidate will be confident using EMIS Web and Docman, able to work independently, manage competing priorities and remain calm and professional in a busy environment. They will understand the importance of confidentiality, accuracy, teamwork and delivering excellent patient care. This is an opportunity to join a dedicated practice team where the reception service plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the surgery. Main duties will include: Welcoming patients and visitors and dealing with enquiries in a friendly, professional and confidential manner. Answering telephone calls, managing patient queries and directing enquiries appropriately. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Using EMIS Web confidently to access and update patient records accurately. Using Docman to manage incoming clinical correspondence and related administrative tasks. Processing patient requests, messages, prescriptions and documents in line with practice protocols. Supporting the GP-led appointment navigation process and ensuring patient requests are recorded accurately. Maintaining accurate patient information, including demographic details and relevant administrative coding. Recognising urgent or potentially concerning requests and escalating them appropriately to the clinical team. Supporting the wider administrative team with referrals, scanning, workflow management and other general practice duties. Maintaining strict patient confidentiality and complying with information governance, safeguarding and data protection requirements. The role requires flexibility, excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload while maintaining a high standard of patient service. Sullivan Way Surgery is seeking an experienced Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice in Wigan. The postholder will provide a professional, efficient and welcoming reception and administrative service to patients, clinicians and colleagues, supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Key Responsibilities Act as the first point of contact for patients, dealing with telephone and face-to-face enquiries professionally and sensitively. Book and manage appointments in line with practice procedures and the GP-led appointment navigation process. Use EMIS Web and Docman confidently to access patient records, process correspondence and complete administrative tasks. Record patient requests and messages accurately and ensure these are directed to the appropriate person. Support referrals, prescription-related enquiries, scanning, workflow management and general administrative duties. Maintain accurate patient records and uphold strict confidentiality and information governance requirements. Recognise urgent concerns and escalate appropriately to the clinical team. Work effectively as part of the wider practice team, managing competing priorities and supporting colleagues when required. Comply with practice policies, safeguarding procedures, health and safety requirements and mandatory training.
